course.description.source: A free course with 17 lessons about AI and the digital world through social studies: where AI came from, who builds it and at what cost, how it changes daily life, and who decides how it is used.
course.description.back: A free course of 17 lessons about AI and the digital world through a social-studies viewpoint, namely: where AI comes from, who builds AI and what it costs (what must be traded for it), how AI changes daily life, and who is the one deciding how AI will be used.
course.description.note: "through social studies" as ผ่านมุมมองสังคมศึกษา (through a social studies lens). Section titles and the practice options are the KEY_TERMS wording.

sections.0.title.source: How AI developed and how it works
sections.0.title.back: How AI developed and how it works

sections.0.question.source: Where did AI come from, and how does it work?
sections.0.question.back: Where does AI come from, and how does it work?

sections.0.description.source: Trace how AI developed from the 1950s to today: the ideas people tried, the setbacks and successes, and what made each change possible. Then see how two of today's approaches work: a model that learns from labelled examples, and a large language model.
sections.0.description.back: Follow how AI developed from the 1950s until today: both the ideas people tried, the failures and the successes, and what made each change possible. Then see how two methods today work: models that learn from labelled examples, and large language models.

sections.1.title.source: Who builds AI, and at what cost
sections.1.title.back: Who builds AI and what must be traded for it

sections.1.question.source: Who makes AI work, and who pays for it?
sections.1.question.back: Who makes AI work, and who is the one who pays?

sections.1.description.source: Meet the people behind AI, weigh the power and water it uses, ask which languages it speaks, and see why it works better for some people than others.
sections.1.description.back: Get to know the people behind AI, weigh up the electricity and water AI uses, ask what languages AI can speak, and see why AI works better for some people than for others.
sections.1.description.note: "weigh the power and water it uses" as ชั่งดูไฟฟ้าและน้ำที่ AI ใช้: "power" made explicit as electricity so it isn't read as อำนาจ.

sections.2.question.source: How is AI changing work, school and community life?
sections.2.question.back: How is AI changing work, school and community life?

sections.2.description.source: Look at how AI changes jobs, health, farming and school, and weigh safety against privacy when cameras can recognise faces.
sections.2.description.back: See how AI changes jobs, health, farming and school, and weigh safety against privacy when cameras can recognise faces.

sections.3.question.source: Who decides what we see, and how AI is used?
sections.3.question.back: Who decides what we will see, and how AI will be used?

sections.3.description.source: Check fake pictures and claims, see how feeds choose what we see, compare the rules people are making for AI, and plan an AI helper for a community.
sections.3.description.back: Check fake pictures and claims, see how feeds choose what we see, compare the rules people are setting for AI, and plan an AI helper for a community.

practiceOptions.3.source: I practised another way (quietly, with sign, or in writing)
practiceOptions.3.back: I practised another way (quietly, using sign language, or writing)
